about: Only the Plavix and Nexium supplied on 2 and 8 August 2026 qualify. The May supply is Somac, which contains pantoprazole.
Brand-only DuoCover and Noxicid are buried in a 12-month history for a fictional adult aged 72, with supplies in March and April 2026.
Brand-only Plavix and Somac are supplied to a fictional adult aged 67. Somac contains pantoprazole, which is excluded from Group B, so there is no finding.
A dated observation confirms outside use with this clopidogrel supply. The record does not show whether the prescriber judged the combination essential, so the finding is possible.
The pharmacy supplied clopidogrel alone and the patient reports taking neither omeprazole nor esomeprazole from another source with it.
The only clopidogrel supply has an observation of unknown outside use. There is no evidence of concurrent omeprazole or esomeprazole use.
